_comment: Cross-language contract for the Sync key-package signature. All values are fictional. Go asserts this in control_plane_test.go; Rust asserts it in src-tauri/src/sync/identity.rs. Both compare against this file rather than against each other. This fixture exists because the two sides had already drifted: Rust signed the raw sealed bytes while Go verified a JSON object that also carried a server-stamped createdAt, so no signature could ever verify and the service skipped verification entirely. That drift is why this fixture exists.
